ITEM 1 | Bright orange cubed pieces, roughly 2-2.5 cm cubes with slightly rounded edges, smooth-to-faintly-netted surface, moist and firm-looking, clustered in the upper-left of the plate covering about 12% of the plate area, stacked in a low mound about 2 cm high | 120
ITEM 2 | Bright green florets, mostly small to medium bunches about 2-3 cm across with dense bushy heads and thin pale stems, slightly glossy and moist, arranged in a cluster on the right side of the plate covering about 12% of the plate area, about 2 cm high | 85
ITEM 3 | Mixed loose salad greens including flat and curly green leaves with some dark red-purple leaves and pale midrib stems, slightly wet and limp, piled in a loose heap covering about 20% of the plate area, about 2-3 cm high, sitting center-left on the plate | 60
ITEM 4 | Single whole cherry tomato, about 2 cm diameter, glossy deep red with a small green stem end, sitting at the center of the plate between the greens and broccoli | 15
